description:
Creates a new email account via EmailAccountService Uses the same service as internal API — handles password hashing, Postfix/Dovecot config, maildir creation, plan limits

HTTP: POST /v1/email-accounts
Category: Email
Required scopes: email:write
Returns: {status, data: any}
Mutating: changes server state.

domain_id.description: UUID of the mail domain — obtain it from GET /v1/domains

quota_mb.description: Mailbox quota in megabytes; 0 = the panel's default mailbox quota

username.description: Local part only (info); the domain's name is appended — used when email is empty

name: panelica_email_post_v1_email_accounts
